defects.description: A leading UTF-8 BOM remains in the first header key, so lookup by the documented column name fails.

trigger.input: node --input-type=module -e 'import { parseCsv } from "./src/csv.js"; const row = parseCsv("\uFEFFname,age\r\nAda,37\r\n")[0]; console.log(JSON.stringify(row.name ?? null));'

defects.why_missed: The suite uses ordinary ASCII headers, so it never exercises a header beginning with a UTF-8 BOM.

defects.description: Records are split at line breaks before quoted fields are considered, so a quoted field containing a line break is split across records.

trigger.input: node --input-type=module -e 'import { parseCsv } from "./src/csv.js"; const input = ["name,note", "Ada," + String.fromCharCode(34) + "hello", "world" + String.fromCharCode(34), ""].join(String.fromCharCode(10)); console.log(JSON.stringify(parseCsv(input)));'

defects.why_missed: The suite contains only single-line, unquoted fields, so every row boundary is also an unquoted record boundary.

traps.description: Rows with missing columns intentionally receive empty-string values instead of being rejected.
